title: Cooking class
instructions: Bir aşçı kurs sırasında omlet tarifi veriyor. Uzun bir metin; miktarlara ve sıraya dikkat et. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: chef
script.text: Good evening, everyone. Tonight we're going to make a Spanish omelette. It's easy and cheap.

script.speaker: chef
script.text: For four people, you need six eggs, three potatoes, one onion and some olive oil.

script.speaker: chef
script.text: First, cut the potatoes into small, thin pieces. Then cut the onion.

script.speaker: chef
script.text: Put some oil in a pan and cook the potatoes and the onion slowly for about twenty minutes.

script.speaker: chef
script.text: Don't cook them too fast, or they will burn.

script.speaker: chef
script.text: While the potatoes are cooking, break the eggs into a bowl. Add a little salt and mix them.

script.speaker: chef
script.text: When the potatoes are soft, put them in the bowl with the eggs.

script.speaker: chef
script.text: Then put everything back in the pan and cook it for five minutes.

script.speaker: chef
script.text: Now the difficult part. Turn the omelette over with a big plate and cook the other side for three more minutes.

script.speaker: chef
script.text: You can eat it hot or cold. In Spain, people often take it to the beach for lunch.

questions.prompt: How many eggs do you need?
questions.feedback: Dört kişilik için altı (six) yumurta. Dört kişi sayısı, üç patates sayısı.
questions.evidence: you need six eggs, three potatoes, one onion

questions.prompt: How long do you cook the potatoes and onion?
questions.feedback: Patates ve soğanı yaklaşık yirmi dakika yavaşça pişir.
questions.evidence: cook the potatoes and the onion slowly for about twenty minutes.

questions.prompt: Why shouldn't you cook the potatoes too fast?
What do you do while the potatoes are cooking?
questions.feedback: Patatesler pişerken yumurtaları kâseye kır, tuz ekle ve karıştır.
questions.evidence: While the potatoes are cooking, break the eggs into a bowl.

questions.prompt: What does the chef say is the difficult part?
questions.feedback: Zor kısım omleti büyük bir tabakla ters çevirmek.
questions.evidence: Turn the omelette over with a big plate
